items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I know I went once to the office myself and I talked to Lee and I showed him the every thing, and he said he liked it.

ctx.x: Now we've mentioned the tunes that you had with various publishing companies, but you said you gave some to Leeds, and I just wondered if there were tunes that we hadn't mentioned yet, and I wanted to get them if we haven't gotten it yet.
I can't remember. I know I went once to the office myself and I talked to Lee and I showed him the every thing, and he said he liked it. Well, later on, I don't know what happened.
